title: Kes on kes?
topic: Rasmus goes to Sunday lunch with his girlfriend Kadri's family, takes her brother for her father and makes friends with her little nephew

sentences.sk: On pühapäev. Rasmus ja Kadri lähevad Kadri vanemate juurde lõunale.
sentences.en: It is Sunday. Rasmus and Kadri are going to Kadri's parents' for lunch.

sentences.sk: Kadri, kes seal on?
sentences.en: Kadri, who will be there?

sentences.sk: Kadri näitab talle pilti.
sentences.en: Kadri shows him a photo.

sentences.sk: Vaata. See on minu isa ja see on minu ema.
sentences.en: Look. This is my father and this is my mother.

sentences.sk: See mees on minu vend Peeter ja see on Peetri naine.
sentences.en: This man is my brother Peeter and this is Peeter's wife.

sentences.sk: Ja see väike poiss on nende poeg Oskar.
sentences.en: And this little boy is their son Oskar.

sentences.sk: Sinu isa ja sinu vend on väga sarnased.
sentences.en: Your father and your brother look very alike.

sentences.sk: Kadri helistab uksekella ja üks mees teeb ukse lahti.
sentences.en: Kadri rings the doorbell, and a man opens the door.

sentences.sk: Tere päevast, härra Tamm! Väga meeldiv.
sentences.en: Good afternoon, Mr. Tamm! Very nice to meet you.

sentences.sk: Ma ei ole Kadri isa. Ma olen Peeter, Kadri vend!
sentences.en: I'm not Kadri's father. I'm Peeter, Kadri's brother!

sentences.sk: Kõik naeravad.
sentences.en: Everyone laughs.

sentences.sk: Köögis teeb Kadri ema süüa ja Kadri isa istub laua taga.
sentences.en: In the kitchen Kadri's mother is cooking and Kadri's father is sitting at the table.

sentences.sk: Tere tulemast meie koju, Rasmus! Kas sul on vend või õde?
sentences.en: Welcome to our home, Rasmus! Do you have a brother or a sister?

sentences.sk: Mul on üks õde. Venda mul ei ole.
sentences.en: I have one sister. I don't have a brother.

sentences.sk: Ja kus sinu pere elab?
sentences.en: And where does your family live?

sentences.sk: Minu ema, isa ja õde elavad Tartus.
sentences.en: My mother, father and sister live in Tartu.

sentences.sk: Pärast lõunat viib väike Oskar Rasmuse oma tuppa.
sentences.en: After lunch little Oskar takes Rasmus to his room.

sentences.sk: See on minu tuba. Siin ma magan.
sentences.en: This is my room. I sleep here.

sentences.sk: Rasmus, kas Kadri meeldib sulle?
sentences.en: Rasmus, do you like Kadri?

sentences.sk: Jah, ta meeldib mulle väga.
sentences.en: Yes, I like her very much.

sentences.sk: Mulle ka. Kadri on minu tädi!
sentences.en: Me too. Kadri is my aunt!

sentences.sk: Siis oled sa nüüd ka minu sõber.
sentences.en: Then now you're my friend too.

sentences.sk: Oskar naerab ja näitab Rasmusele kõiki oma mänguautosid.
sentences.en: Oskar laughs and shows Rasmus all his toy cars.

questions.q: Kus elavad Rasmuse ema ja isa?

recap: Before Sunday lunch Kadri shows Rasmus a photo of her family. At the door he greets her brother Peeter as her father, which makes everyone laugh, and after lunch he makes friends with Peeter's little son Oskar.

talle.gloss: he, she (talle: to him, to her)

meeldiv.gloss: pleasant (väga meeldiv: nice to meet you)

teeb.gloss: to do, to make (teeb lahti: opens; teeb süüa: cooks)
